baseline_models.focus_anchor: The completed verb سَبَّحَ is directed لِلَّهِ, while repeated ما في spans the heavens and the earth.
baseline_models.mechanism: The upper cover and lower ground close the vertical field, and every occupant within it participates in worship directed to the worshipped One.

activation_trace.role: Praise and prayer supply the devotional act performed across the whole field.
The worshipped One supplies the act's single direction rather than another member of the field.
The overhead sky and cover establish the upper extent of the universal enclosure.
Lower ground opposite the sky closes the enclosure from below.

changed_reading.before: A formula saying that everything praises God.
changed_reading.after: A vertically complete field of beings jointly performing directed devotion.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: سَبَّحَ stands inside the paired spatial containers في السماوات and في الأرض and ends with العزيز الحكيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: Tasbih as swimming or coursing makes the contents of heaven and earth moving trajectories; overcoming power and firm ordering keep those trajectories coherent.

activation_trace.role: Swimming and coursing turn praise from speech into motion through a medium.
The overhead expanse supplies an upper medium for coursing.
The lower ground supplies the counter-domain traversed or inhabited.
Overcoming power supplies the force under which no trajectory escapes the total order.
Firm and perfected ordering supplies stable form to universal motion.

changed_reading.after: Creation praises by coursing within an invincible, precisely ordered system.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The act سَبَّحَ is followed by the exclusive direction لله and the paired names العزيز الحكيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: Tasbih removes defect and false likeness; inaccessibility blocks encroachment on divine uniqueness, while wise restraint turns corruption back.

activation_trace.role: Exoneration and declaring free make tasbih a subtractive act against false attribution.
Rarity and inaccessibility mark a boundary that created analogues cannot cross.
Restraint that turns corruption back gives the boundary a corrective function.

changed_reading.before: Tasbih adds praise to a divine description.
changed_reading.after: Tasbih polices the creator-creature boundary by stripping away corrupt attribution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The universal subject ما في السماوات وما في الأرض is sealed by العزيز الحكيم.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hard cohesion and perfected firmness allow the world's very consistency, not only its voices, to function as praise.

activation_trace.role: Devotional praise supplies the function that material coherence is proposed to perform.
Hard ground and cohesion supply a material image of parts holding together.
Perfected firmness makes held-together form an expression of wisdom.

changed_reading.after: The world's durable composition itself performs praise by exhibiting coherent order.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus juxtaposes السماوات and الأرض inside one repeated ما في construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The dominant sky branch preserves the upper cover, while a non-dominant mapped branch images first rain marking fertile earth with growth; heaven and earth become an imprinting interface rather than isolated zones.

activation_trace.role: The overhead cover preserves the ordinary spatial reading of heavens.
First rain visibly marking earth with growth supplies a downward imprint from the split mapping.
Soft fertile ground supplies the receiving surface on which the upper mark becomes life.
Coursing supplies the movement by which the upper and lower domains interact.

changed_reading.before: Heavens and earth are two exhaustive locations containing praisers.
changed_reading.after: The upper and lower domains form a living interface where descent, imprint, and growth enact praise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate contrast between emitted speech and produced action, intensified by abhorrence, retroactively prevents سَبَّحَ from being reduced to utterance: valid praise is correspondence between declaration and deed.

activation_trace.role: Devotional praise supplies the baseline act whose adequacy is being retested.
Producing speech by vocalization isolates the verbal side of the mismatch.
Bringing an act into being supplies the missing embodied side.
Severe aversion to ugliness makes incongruence a corruption of praise, not a minor lapse.

structural_cues: 61:2-3 repeat تقولون and تفعلون after 61:1's completed universal verb, with the same negated gap twice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated speech/action mismatch and severe aversion; I infer mismatch -> failed tasbih, while a live alternative is that the admonition does not redefine 61:1.

changed_reading.before: Universal tasbih may be heard chiefly as praise said or recited.
changed_reading.after: Universal tasbih sets a norm of enacted congruence in which speech must acquire the shape of action.

context_deltas.mechanism: A straight row becomes a structure by joining part to part and compacting it firmly; this gives the focus's cohesive praise a social mechanism of aligned plurality rather than undifferentiated mass.

activation_trace.role: Cohesive solidity supplies the focus-side material capacity to hold together.
Perfected firmness supplies the ordered quality of the resulting whole.
Alignment on one level line supplies coordinated orientation among distinct agents.
Joining one part to another supplies the compositional operation.
Tight compacting supplies resistance to gaps and fracture.

structural_cues: The simile كأنهم بنيان مرصوص translates a human row into load-bearing construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies line, assembly, and compaction; I infer coordinated adjacency -> a human instance of cosmic coherence, while a live alternative confines the image to battle formation.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic praise appears as the stable consistency of a finished whole.
changed_reading.after: Cosmic praise can be instantiated by distinct agents aligning, closing gaps, and becoming a load-bearing whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: Coursing within wise order gains a failure mode: an initial departure from straightness is answered by a further turning of the heart, whereas guidance gently indicates a path.

activation_trace.role: Coursing supplies directed movement whose orientation can be maintained or lost.
Corrective restraint supplies the focus-side possibility of turning disorder back.
Departure from straightness supplies both the initiating deflection and its causative echo.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the internal reversal produced in the heart.
Gentle indication toward path and truth supplies the non-deviant orientation.

structural_cues: فلما links the two adjacent forms زاغوا and أزاغ as an explicit response sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies initial deviation, causative deviation, heart, and path-guidance; I infer chosen bend -> reinforced orientation, while a live alternative reads only a local punitive sequence.

changed_reading.before: All created motion simply remains inside wise order.
changed_reading.after: Human movement can resist universal alignment, and repeated deviation can become an inwardly self-reinforcing course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurrence of س م و as اسم activates raised designation and visible marking alongside the focus's sky sense; repeated disclosure and fulfilled correspondence make the heavens a legible sign-field, not only a location.

activation_trace.role: The upper cover retains the ordinary spatial anchor of السماوات.
A name as raised designation supplies public naming to the shared root.
A visible identifying mark preserves the non-dominant semiotic activation.
Meaning disclosed through speech or sign supplies the act of reading the mark.
Fulfillment that matches promise and act makes a designation evidential rather than nominal only.

structural_cues: The packet assigns both السماوات in 61:1 and اسمه in 61:6 to س م و, while 61:6 repeats ب ي ن across position, proofs, and manifest judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a shared QAC root, split inventories, and repeated disclosure; I infer spatial height + designation -> legibility, while a live alternative keeps sky and name senses entirely separate.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are an upper container populated by praisers.
changed_reading.after: The heavens also function as a raised, publicly readable designation whose ordered signs perform praise.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fabricated attribution and speech contrary to truth are opposed by a call toward wholeness and freedom from defect, sharpening tasbih into resistance to counterfeit claims about God.

activation_trace.role: Declaring free from defect supplies the focus-side operation of removing false attribution.
Invented falsehood supplies the active manufacture of a counterfeit divine claim.
Contradiction of truth supplies the content removed by exonerating praise.
Soundness and freedom from defects supply the positive condition restored after falsehood is stripped away.

structural_cues: 61:7 places fabrication against God inside a passive call toward الإسلام, then repeats the refusal of guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies forged attribution, falsity, and a call to soundness; I infer counterfeit claim -> need for exonerating tasbih, while a live alternative treats Islam here only as communal allegiance.

changed_reading.before: Exoneration generally denies imperfection of God.
changed_reading.after: Exoneration is an active epistemic practice that detects, strips, and refuses fabricated speech about God.

context_deltas.mechanism: Speech-openings try to cool a flame, but illumination reaches completion and truth is brought into the open; العزيز الحكيم now reads as the force and perfected ordering of a disclosure that converts resistance into further manifestation.

activation_trace.role: Overcoming supplies the inability of hostile resistance to master the process.
Perfected decisiveness supplies the process's completion rather than mere survival.
Cooling flame and stilling embers supply the intended interruption.
Light and illumination supply the propagating object that resists interruption.
Opening the mouth in speech supplies the inadequate instrument of suppression.
Reaching full completion supplies the reversal of attempted extinguishing.
Establishing and displaying truth converts illumination into verified disclosure.
Emergence into view supplies the public endpoint of the process.

structural_cues: 61:8 opposes يريدون ليطفئوا to والله متم, and 61:8-9 repeat ولو كره before the purpose clause ليظهره.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attempted extinguishing, completion, truth, and emergence; I infer resistance -> intensified disclosure under the focus names, while a live alternative treats light as a separate message metaphor.

changed_reading.before: 61:1 reports universal praise as a completed cosmic fact.
changed_reading.after: Universal praise is also a resistant disclosure process that hostile mouths cannot stop and may inadvertently make more visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The anonymous human portion of ما في is specified as effort under hardship along an extended path, using both accumulated resources and the life-bearing self; human tasbih becomes costly alignment rather than automatic membership.

activation_trace.role: Devotional action supplies the universal field into which deliberate human participation enters.
Exerting full capacity under hardship supplies the intensity of participation.
An extended traversable path supplies direction rather than undirected expenditure.
Possessed and accumulated wealth supplies external capacity committed to the path.
The self by which life exists supplies the participant's irreducible personal stake.

structural_cues: 61:11 pairs بأموالكم and أنفسكم under one تجاهدون and repeats the focus preposition في in في سبيل الله.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies effort, path, wealth, and living selves; I infer these resources -> the human mode of universal tasbih, while a live alternative limits them to the trade proposition of 61:10-12.

changed_reading.before: Humans are anonymous occupants already included in universal praise.
changed_reading.after: Humans enter that praise deliberately by aligning path, resources, and life under costly effort.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's coursing and rain-marked sky-earth interface receives an ecology: water cuts and flows below while gardens cover and dwellings settle above, so governed movement produces rest and fertility rather than motion for its own sake.

activation_trace.role: Coursing supplies the focus-side kinetic model.
Rain marking earth with growth supplies the vertical transfer from upper to lower.
Fertile ground supplies the receptive material in which circulation becomes growth.
Flowing and spreading supply continuous movement through the lower landscape.
The explicit underside fixes the flow's vertical relation to habitation and gardens.
A river cutting earth with running water supplies a channel that joins movement to terrain.
Dwelling in a home supplies stable rest supported by the hidden flow.
A garden concealed by dense trees supplies the fertile covering produced around the flow.

structural_cues: 61:12 repeats gardens around the clause تجري من تحتها الأنهار and then places settled dwellings within them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies downward relation, running rivers, gardens, and dwellings; I infer circulation -> fertility and rest, while a live alternative reads these only as future reward images.

changed_reading.before: Sky and earth interact through an abstract downward imprint, and tasbih is coursing motion.
changed_reading.after: Their praise can be read as a hydrological cycle in which hidden movement marks earth with growth and sustains settled life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Victory opens, supporters take up a role, divine reinforcement supplies force, and they become visibly prevailing; العزيز shifts from a static title to might enacted through a relay without ceasing to originate from God.

activation_trace.role: Reinforcing and strengthening supply the focus name's transmissible effect.
Aid that makes its recipient manifest supplies the first outward effect of divine might.
The opening of victory supplies transition from blocked potential to achieved outcome.
Coming into an actual state supplies the commanded human assumption of support.
Repeated aid and manifestation make support a circulating relation among God, messenger, and responders.
Confirming force supplies the explicit divine input into the human group.
Rising above and prevailing supply the visible result of reinforcement.

structural_cues: 61:13 marks نصر as من الله; 61:14 repeats أنصار three times, then links أيدنا to فأصبحوا ظاهرين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divine aid, commanded supporters, reinforcement, and a result; I infer divine force -> enacted communal strength, while a live alternative keeps العزيز wholly separate from the closing victory sequence.

changed_reading.before: العزيز names might possessed by God alone as a static predicate.
changed_reading.after: العزيز also names an originating power whose reinforcement becomes visible in aligned agents without transferring its source.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Applying a literal bridle-piece to cosmic motion is materially surprising, but it remains anchored in سَبَّحَ as coursing, الحكيم's restraint branch, and the later straight/deviant path contrast; render it only as a governing-motion analogy, not as a lexical replacement for الحكيم.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of coursing-capable سَبَّحَ and الحكيم permits motion and restraint to be heard together.

activation_trace.role: Swimming or coursing supplies a body in directed motion.
The jaw-fitting that restrains an animal supplies the concrete image of governing motion.
Deviation from straightness supplies the motion that has escaped its line.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies guidance as an alternative to violent restraint.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic praise is spontaneous free motion.
changed_reading.after: Cosmic praise may also be imagined as powerful motion kept true by wise, minimally sufficient restraint.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The narrow-aperture image comes from the non-dominant س م م target of the focus root and is therefore branch-distant, yet it is anchored in السماوات and activated by mouths confronting light; render it as a spatial analogy about attempted constriction, never as a translation of السماوات.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus word السماوات carries a split mapped inventory while still naming the vast upper domain.

activation_trace.role: A narrow opening through which something enters supplies the deliberately form-distant aperture image.
The open mouth supplies a concrete small outlet opposed to the heavens' breadth.
Illumination supplies what hostile speech tries to confine to an aperture but cannot contain.

changed_reading.before: The heavens are simply the widest upper container.
changed_reading.after: Their vast praise can be contrasted with the tiny oral apertures that try, unsuccessfully, to constrict divine illumination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Activating the wood-eating termite off الأرض against the compact building is lexically remote and should not redefine earth, but it remains rooted in the focus and creates a coherent material counter-reading; render it as an ecological possibility that construction and hidden decomposition coexist under wise restraint.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ما في الأرض explicitly includes hidden earthly agents, while العزيز الحكيم permits solidity and correction to coexist.

activation_trace.role: The concealed wood-eating agent supplies decomposition from within the earthly field.
Restraint for correction supplies a limit that prevents breakdown from becoming meaningless chaos.
Joining parts supplies the constructive process exposed to internal undoing.
Tight compaction supplies the strongest local image against which hidden decomposition registers.

changed_reading.before: Earthly praise appears chiefly as stable ground and compact construction.
changed_reading.after: Earthly praise may include a regulated cycle in which hidden decomposition tests and remakes even tightly assembled forms.

strongest_changes: The saying/doing contrast changes tasbih from utterance into enacted correspondence.
Row, assembly, and compaction turn cosmic coherence into coordinated social architecture.
Attempted extinguishing, completion, and manifestation turn a completed report into resistant disclosure.
Running rivers beneath gardens and dwellings turn coursing into life-sustaining circulation.
Aid, reinforcement, and visible prevalence turn العزيز from a static predicate into originating might enacted through aligned agents.
summary.what_was_special: The split س م و inventory kept several live readings together: heavens as upper cover, raised designation, rain-marked interface, visible sign, and, at the far edge, an aperture contrast. Material branches also let motion, structure, restraint, growth, disclosure, and decomposition coexist without forcing one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: The speech/action admonition may test 61:1 retroactively, or it may remain only an adjacent human correction.
The non-dominant س م و mappings are packet-authorized activators but remain exploratory rather than lexical claims about السماوات.
The building, hydrological, and victory sequences may instantiate cosmic praise, or may remain local analogies beside it.
The completed past سَبَّحَ may foreground an accomplished fact even where context activates ongoing process readings.
